# … 幾多錢？ · *… gei2 do1 cin2?*

**Meaning:** How much is…? · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

Put 幾多錢 after the thing you are asking about. Prices are answered with a number + 蚊 (man1, dollars): 三十蚊.

**Written Chinese:** 多少錢 — Written Chinese uses 多少.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **一杯奶茶幾多錢呀？** |
| Jyutping | jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3? |
| Yale | yāt būi náaih chàh géi dō chín a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㆵ¹ ㄅㄨㄧ¹ ㄋㄚㄧ⁵ ㄘㄚ⁴ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄘㄧㄣ² ㄚ³? |
| English | How much is a milk tea? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢件衫幾多錢呀？** |
| Jyutping | ni1 gin6 saam1 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3? |
| Yale | nī gihn sāam géi dō chín a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄍㄧㄣ⁶ ㄙㄚㆬ¹ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄘㄧㄣ² ㄚ³? |
| English | How much is this top? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **去機場幾多錢呀？** |
| Jyutping | heoi3 gei1 coeng4 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3? |
| Yale | heui gēi chèuhng géi dō chín a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄍㄝㄧ¹ ㄘㆦㄥ⁴ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄘㄧㄣ² ㄚ³? |
| English | How much is it to the airport? |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~這個多少錢？~~ → ✓ **呢個幾多錢呀？** *ni1 go3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?* · *nī go géi dō chín a?*  
  這 and 多少 are written forms.
